Attendee.title: Attendee
Attendee.description: Represents an attendee participating in the seminar.

name.description: The full name of the attendee.

department.description: The department within the attendee's affiliation.

position.description: The job title or position of the attendee.

email.description: The email address of the attendee.

creatorId.description: The Firebase UID of the user who created the entry.

education.description: The educational background of the attendee.

experience.description: The professional experience of the attendee.

Question.title: Question
Question.description: A question submitted by an attendee.

creatorId.description: The Firebase UID of the user who submitted the question.

sessionId.description: The ID of the presentation session this question belongs to.

attendeeName.description: The name of the attendee who submitted the question.

attendeeAffiliation.description: The affiliation of the attendee who submitted the question.

Presenter.title: Presenter
Presenter.description: Represents a speaker or presenter at the seminar.

name.description: The full name of the presenter.

bio.description: A short biography of the presenter.

imageUrl.description: A URL to the presenter's profile image.

ScheduleItem.title: Schedule Item
ScheduleItem.description: Represents a single item in the seminar schedule.

order.description: The display order of the schedule item.

title.description: The title of the schedule item.

presenter.description: The name of the presenter(s) for this item.

time.description: The time slot for this schedule item (e.g., '09:00 - 09:15').

description.description: A brief description of the schedule item.

downloadUrl.description: A general URL for downloadable materials.

downloadUrlKorean.description: A URL for Korean downloadable materials.

downloadUrlMongolian.description: A URL for Mongolian downloadable materials.

isSession.description: Indicates if this item is a presentation session eligible for Q&A.

details.description: A list of detailed points about the session.

/attendees/{attendeeId}.description: Stores information about each seminar attendee.
